text: E2E_SM_DEINIT | E2E_SM_INIT - COMMUNICATION INITIALIZATION - for queued reception: do NOT | use data. For unqueued reception: configured | InitValue might be provided. | E2E_SM_VALID - communication within limits - | ok to USE data | E2E_SM_INVALID - communication not within | limits - do NOT use data | E2E_SM_NODATA - wait for 1st reception - do | NOT use data | [too many ERRORs or WrongSequence or NoNewData or Repeated] | [NOT (too many ERRORs or too few OKs)] | init | [NOT (too many ERRORs or too few OKs)] | 1st Data with no ERROR | [too many ERRORs or too few OKs] | [too many errors or | NoNewData]
